volt1geur.text: Volt1geur fights at the very top of the tracked population, with a matchup rating and resistance both among the very best. The pace is measured rather than frantic, and the headshot share is thin, yet the matchup kill-death line stays near the top. The lifetime board undersells the whole picture, painting a far lower IvI than the matchups support.

valrynnc.text: ValrynNC brings volume and venom: the lifetime kill-death line sits in the highest tier, and the matchups back it up. The trigger keeps a good clip, the edge stays strong while the opposition gets tougher, and the kept share holds firm against the strongest third. A strong regular with a ledger to match.

verylowskillsandveryfewkills.text: VeryLowSkillsandVeryFewKills has been at this since 2012, and the card reads like a long apprenticeship paid off: matchup rating and bravery up near the very top, resistance higher still, plus a matchup kill-death mark to match. Pace sits comfortably in the top ranks, the aim is precise, as the lifetime board puts them a little below the matchups. The one soft note is headshot share, merely middling, but the results speak for themselves.

vsaier.text: VSaier plays a precise, high-tempo game: the rating is top-rank, and so are activity, bravery, and resistance, with pace to match. The aim sits in the top ranks, though the headshot share runs mid-pack, and the lifetime ledger marks them a notch below the matchups. The strongest third drops the game below the pack — the soft seam in a strong card.

vocaloidia.text: VocaloidIA has been at this since 2015, and the craft is plain: the matchup kill-death mark sits in the upper tier, and so do rating, tempo, bravery, and resistance. Accuracy sits top-shelf, the headshot share above average, and the lifetime IvI sits in the upper tier too. Consistency alone sits middling on a long, distinguished card.

voidy6vanu.text: Voidy6Vanu plays a complete, high-tempo game: rating, activity, and bravery all run near the very top, with output and resistance sitting close behind. The aim is sharp, headshots plentiful, and the results keep their shape as the opposition improves. The lifetime board rates them top-shelf too — every line on the card reads strong.

vindictusdefyingfate.text: VindictusDefyingFate earns every win twice over: at the top end of the matchup board, unshaken by quick-killing opposition, and a lifetime kill-death record near the top. The tempo runs above the middle, the aim ordinary, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack — the matchups tell the stronger story. Consistency against the hardest third holds up well, the quiet seal on a strong card.

varettte.text: Varettte arrived in 2026 and has taken no time settling in: a top-shelf rating, a scorching tempo, and headshots among the sharpest tracked. The lifetime numbers echo the matchups, and the grip stays firm in the hardest third. A rising fighter with the whole road ahead.

vsnb.text: VSnB wins matchups without ever looking rushed: a top-tier rating, resistance near the top, and a head-to-head kill-death line near the top. The pace sits mid-pack and headshots land below average, which keeps the card honest. The lifetime board tells a middling story beside the matchups, which carry the real weight.

vexarivs.text: VexariVS is a fresh name with a loud opening: in the upper tier of the matchup rankings, fast hands, and calm when the stakes climb. The accuracy is already precise, and the lifetime numbers back the matchups up. Early days, but the opening is hard to ignore.

vspingping.text: VSpingping plays at full throttle: upper-tier matchup rating, a tempo up near the top, with bravery that rises as the fighting hardens. The lifetime board backs the matchups across the card. The one wrinkle in a fast, fearless game: the edge dips against the hardest third.
